claim: Anyone ever use FedEx OnSite at Walgreens? : r/Flipping - Reddit
summary: So apparently FedEx has a deal with Walgreens where you can drop off their packages there and they'll accept then. They're claiming that when you give them your package it scans as Accepted in their site, the same as if you went to FedEx Office or FedEx Distro facility. Can anyone confirm this is true and if they've ever had any problems using the Walgreens sites? I have a 2Day Air shipment so ...
